done_when: After a full run of Forge's test suite, no process started by a test (Codex SDK stubs, app-server stubs, drivers) is left running or stopped: tests that stop a process always resume and end it in their cleanup, including when the test fails. A check at the end of the suite fails when a test left one behind and names the test.

findings.body: The regression test has no independent cleanup for the children it starts. If the guard misses the running child, the assertion at line 57 fails while that child continues sleeping. The outer fixture searches for the outer test's temp path, but the child inherits the nested test's XDG_CONFIG_HOME (tests/conftest.py:105–106) and its command contains no outer path, so that fixture cannot end it. Track the child PIDs and terminate and wait for them in a finally block, including when an assertion fails or the nested pytest run times out.
findings.title: Not done: After a full run of Forge's test suite, no process started by a test (Codex SDK stubs, app-server stubs, drivers) is left running

why: Forge's own test suite leaves stopped Codex SDK stub processes behind (63 found, up to four days old, parented to init), which pile up on developer machines
